tasks.gr11-prose-poetry-visual-literacy-t2: Topic: Continued prose and poetry study with visual literacy for Grade 11 English HL. Cover seen and unseen poetry comparison, prose analysis, and visual text interpretation including photographs, cartoons, advertisements, and infographics. Ask learners to compare two poems using evidence, identify visual-literacy devices, explain how colour and composition create meaning, answer quote-based questions on prose, and integrate textual and visual evidence in a response.
tasks.gr11-advanced-essay-functional-writing-t: Topic: Advanced essay writing and formal functional writing for Grade 11 English HL. Cover discursive and reflective essays, agendas, minutes, formal reports, and magazine articles. Ask learners to identify the distinguishing features of each text type, select the correct format and register for a functional task, write an opening paragraph for a discursive essay, set out formal minutes correctly, and evaluate whether a piece of writing meets its stated purpose.
tasks.gr11-summary-writing-technique-t2: Topic: Summary writing technique for Grade 11 English HL Paper 1. Cover identifying main points, paraphrasing in own words, keeping to the required word limit, and writing a summary in continuous prose. Ask learners to select the correct number of main ideas from a passage, rewrite direct quotes as paraphrases, combine notes into coherent summary sentences, explain why quotation is penalised in summaries, and write a complete summary response within a word limit.
tasks.gr11-midyear-exam-preparation-t2: Topic: Mid-year examination preparation for Grade 11 English HL covering all three papers. Cover Paper 1 routines (comprehension, summary, language), Paper 2 literature recall and contextual questions, and Paper 3 essay and transactional writing under timed conditions. Ask learners to identify which paper tests which skill, answer sample contextual questions, plan a timed essay, apply summary technique under pressure, and describe strategies for managing time across the three papers.
tasks.gr11-dialogue-interview-t2: Topic: Dialogues and interviews (Grade 11 English HL, Term 2 oral). Cover features of a dialogue, the five phases of an interview, open and closed questions, follow-up questions, active listening and the usual durations. Ask questions directly to 'you'.
tasks.gr11-panel-informal-discussion-t2: Topic: Panel and informal discussions (Grade 11 English HL, Term 2 oral). Cover informal discussion skills, panel roles, the duties of the chairperson, conventional phrases and listening for appreciation and interaction. Ask questions directly to 'you'.
